_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.12 (Space Age enabled) via the test/oracle harness. The two probability expressions Vulcanus's rock ENTITIES use (vulcanus_rock_huge, vulcanus_rock_big; the -hot variants reuse them) plus the vulcanus_decorative_knockout noise they read, routed onto elevation over a grid spanning spawn (fine -256..256/32 plus a coarser -800..800/160 span) and far rings at r=1500/3000 snapped to 1/256, against a real Vulcanus surface (game.planets['vulcanus'].create_surface()). Regenerate: node --experimental-strip-types test/oracle/capture.ts vulcanus-rocks
